212:t_1:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...How long has it been since we got separated from $c...?」

212:t_1:9.en:
$n
「We're sending out a distress signal. $c will surely find us.」

212:t_1:10.en:
$n
「We were sent flying by that $$時空震動$$, so everyone should be nearby.」

212:t_1:12.en:
$n
「It'll be all right, Miss $$スズネ$$. There's no way that $$ＡＧ$$ would abandon $$ジェニオン$$, its prized possession.」

212:t_1:13.en:
$n
「That $$ＡＧ$$ will use its boasted dimensional merchant information network, or whatever it takes, to find us.」

212:t_1:15.en:
$n
「There's an emergency survival kit inside $$ジェニオン$$, and our suits are... um...」

212:t_1:16.en:
$n
「...they can automatically break down bodily waste and transfer it away, too...」

212:t_1:17.en:
$n
「And as a last resort, there's the option of using the cold sleep function.」

212:t_1:23.en:
$n
「I was wondering... if $$宗介$$ is safe...」

212:t_1:25.en:
$n
「Not just $$宗介$$... I was thinking about everyone in $c... and about Earth, too.」

212:t_1:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even though we don't know what will happen to ourselves...?」

212:t_1:27.en:
$n
「I can manage what's mine to manage if I act on it myself.」

212:t_1:28.en:
$n
「But when it comes to other people... all I can do is wait...」

212:t_1:29.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're positive even in a situation like this...」

212:t_1:30.en:
$n
「It was Miss $$スズネ$$ and everyone else who taught me that.」

212:t_1:32.en:
$n
「Everybody gets down sometimes. So for now, I'll protect you, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

212:t_1:33.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Ever since you boarded $$ジェニオン$$, $n, you've been protecting me the whole time.」

212:t_1:34.en:
$n
「That's not true. I'm the one who's been protected.」

212:t_1:35.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Protecting, and being protected... I think that's what being partners is.」

212:t_1:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「In my case, a teacher's sense of responsibility gets added on top, though.」

212:t_1:37.en:
$n
「But the special training program is over now, isn't it? The closing ceremony was supposed to be yesterday.」

212:t_1:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then from now on, will you call me $$スズネ$$?」

212:t_1:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What if we just keep drifting through space, the two of us, and when we reach some star, we become Adam and Eve there?」

212:t_1:43.en:
$n
「It's not that, but I'm not mentally prepared...!」

212:t_1:46.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm joking. Do you feel a little better?」

212:t_1:47.en:
$n
「Better...? You're the one who was down, $$スズネ$$.」

212:t_1:51.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, $n. Lately... all I do is get help from you.」

212:t_1:52.en:
$n
「Was I able to repay you a little?」

212:t_1:53.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You finished repaying that long ago...」

212:t_1:55.en:
$n
「...I've been thinking about it this whole time. What can someone like me, who's always had everyone's help, do with $$ジェニオン$$...」

212:t_1:56.en:
$n
「As my answer, I've been fighting, trying to get stronger so I could protect someone, but...」

212:t_1:57.en:
$n
「Only recently have I started to understand, just a little, that what I was lacking is strength in the true sense.」

212:t_1:59.en:
$n
「Not clinging to convenient hopes, and not going reckless in despair, but doing what I'm supposed to do...」

212:t_1:60.en:
$n
「When I can do that... I think I'll be able to get even stronger.」

212:t_1:61.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Could you mean that time at $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

212:t_1:62.en:
$n
「In that moment... I felt like I'd gotten past something, just a little.」

212:t_1:63.en:
$n
(If I can gain that strength, then surely Mom too...)

212:t_1:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
「A proximity warning...! Has $c come for us...!?」

212:t_1:65.en:
$n
「...There's no identification signal... This is... something we don't know.」

212:t_1:67.en:
$n
「This many... this speed... We can't outrun them.」

212:t_1:69.en:
$n
「I don't know what's coming, but we have no choice but to make contact.」

212:t_1:70.en:
$n
「For now, let's do everything we can to survive.」

212:t_1:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n is scared too... But he must be hiding it so I won't worry...)

212:t_1:74.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What do I do... Even in a situation like this... my heart won't stop pounding...)

212:t_1:75.en:
$$スズネ$$
(...I've decided, $n... No matter what happens, I'll follow you...)

212:t_1:76.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Even if the end of the world is closing in, I believe in the strength you're aiming for.)

213:t_000:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank goodness... You've been unconscious all this time...」
